instantiated_cells.cited_section: Tex. Gov’t Code §§ 305.031 (criminal penalties), 305.032 (civil penalty for failure to register), 305.033 (civil penalty for late filing), 305.021 (false communications prohibited)
instantiated_cells.justification: Chapter 305 expressly creates criminal and civil penalties for violations including failure to register and late filings, and prohibits knowingly making false statements to influence legislation or administrative action.

The statute provides for the commission to determine lateness and whether required forms were filed and to pursue penalties/complaints, but it does not require any regular independent third-party audit or periodic auditing of lobbying disclosure records.
